title: Qualify unnecessary-check detection on the single-pass trace
objective: Expose the existing single-pass validation result as a complete validation trace, consume that same JSON with the unnecessary-check detector, add focused adversarial qualification, and fail bootstrap on overvalidation or undervalidation without executing validation twice.
non_goals: rerun T0 T1 T2 or T3/T4 selection for detector qualification
change canonical T1 T2 or T3/T4 selection semantics
execute T3 assurance or T4 certification

required_invariants: the detector consumes the JSON already emitted by the existing single-pass validation step
incremental validation adds only trace metadata and does not rerun or alter T0 T1 T2 or selector decisions
trace impact families come from the already-computed T0 impact result
trace risk class comes from the already-computed selector result
bootstrap detector qualification occurs after the single-pass measurement and does not execute validation again
overvalidation undervalidation and mixed mismatch are fail-closed bootstrap outcomes
adversarial qualification covers symbolic extras omissions duplicate stages unnecessary execution and missing required pytest
no new dependency network call paid service or larger runner is introduced
acceptance_criteria: single-pass JSON contains trace_version impact_families and risk_class plus all detector-required fields
current exact single-pass trace returns CLEAN
documentation-only R1 synthetic trace returns CLEAN with no T1 T2 T3 T4 work
workflow/security synthetic trace requires exactly its T3 requirements
R3 synthetic trace requires the canonical strengthened T3/T4 obligations
repeated T0/T1/T2/selector invocation is detected as overvalidation
extra symbolic work pytest full-suite network deep-assurance or certification execution is detected as overvalidation
missing checks groups requirements stages or required pytest is detected as undervalidation
mixed extra and missing work returns MISMATCH
at least 18 focused adversarial probes pass
bootstrap and Security Secrets pass on the same exact head

target_commands: bootstrap detector evaluation on existing incremental-validation.json

done_when: current single-pass trace is CLEAN without tier recomputation
at least 18 adversarial detector probes pass
bootstrap fails closed on unnecessary or missing validation work
bootstrap and Security Secrets pass on the same exact head
ENG-08.2 can transition to ENG-08.3 without changing validation semantics
